class.name: unitree_hg_ros2_control/UnitreeHgSystemInterface
class.description: Generic ros2_control hardware interface for Unitree unitree_hg humanoid bodies (G1, H2). Communicates via the Unitree SDK over DDS using the unitree_hg LowCmd/LowState channels. Joint-to-SDK-motor mapping is selected via the robot_variant hardware parameter (g1 or h2).

class.name: unitree_hg_ros2_control/UnitreeDex3SystemInterface
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the Unitree Dex3 three-finger hands. Communicates via the Unitree SDK over DDS using the unitree_hg HandCmd/HandState channels (rt/dex3/{left,right}/{cmd,state}).
